title: IANA Protocol Numbers Registry

date.notes: Registry last-updated value observed during the August 2026 excavation.

claims_extracted.claim: The registry identifies values used for the IPv4 Protocol field and the IPv6 Next Header field.
Current assignments include 1=ICMP, 6=TCP, 17=UDP, 47=GRE, 50=ESP, 51=AH, 58=ICMPv6 and 89=OSPF, while historical protocols such as GGP, PUP and HMP remain visible in the same namespace.

notes: A live registry combining strongly deployed protocol identities with historical/deprecated branches.
